Coram : S. J. MUKHOPADHAYA*, KURIAN JOSEPH
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908: A B c 0. 15, r. 5 - Striking off the defence - Suit for eviction on ground for default in payment of rent - Tenant filing written statement belatedly - Application by land-lord for striking off the defence as defendant failed to deposit the rent even after receipt by trial court and revisional court 0 - Order set aside .by High Court in a petition under Art. 227 of Constitution - Held: Trial court fully applied its mind while exercising its discretionary power to strike off the defence - Revisional court noticed the grounds and, exercising its revisional
Decision Date : 30-08-2013 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7279/2013 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
